requirements.description: The user wants the building located near healthcare services. Per the request, proximity to healthcare is preferred, so the threshold is set at the 75th percentile of the healthcare distribution (75.06, rounded to 75).

The user explicitly requires a gross floor area of at least 360 sqm, so the filter is surface_area >= 360. The 18-person capacity is not converted into an area threshold because no verified gross-area-per-occupant value was supplied by the RegulatoryAgent. Turin is a city, not a cadastral code, so comune_code is not set and is left to the Location Agent. Healthcare proximity and energy class are outside the reference columns and are not filtered.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 360 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND healthcare >= 75 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters offices (property_type 'Uffici e assimilabili') with surface_area of at least 360 sqm, within 3.0 km of the given coordinates, and healthcare proximity score >= 75. No energy filter, since none was required. Results are ordered by haversine distance from the coordinates, nearest first.
